title: Heavy rains in Chiba leave 10 dead and thousands of vehicles abandoned
summary: Record rainfall caused flooding, isolated nursing homes, and forced residents to evacuate as searches for the missing continue.

title: Long-term interest rates rise to 2.93%, highest level in 30 years
summary: The yield on 10-year Japanese government bonds reached 2.93% driven by speculation of a Bank of Japan rate hike.

title: Japan's GDP grows 1.1% annualized in Q2, third consecutive increase
summary: The Japanese economy logs three straight quarters of expansion thanks to export growth and falling oil imports, though domestic demand remains weak.

title: Trump orders drastic reduction in military exercises with South Korea to pressure on costs
summary: The former U.S. president demands greater financial contribution from Seoul and suggests dialogue with Kim Jong-un, creating uncertainty over deterrence on the peninsula.

title: Nishimonai Bon Odori festival, intangible heritage, draws visitors to Akita
summary: The traditional dance of over 700 years, designated an intangible cultural heritage, is performed with elegant movements evoking the world of yūgen.

title: Kumamoto earthquake: public demolitions begin and two-story temporary housing built
summary: Following the 2024 quakes, authorities start subsidized demolition of damaged homes and erect provisional housing for the displaced, while igusa farmers lament severe losses.

title: Young woman in cardiopulmonary arrest after being swept away by Koma River in Hanno during barbecue
summary: A 20-year-old woman was rescued by friends after falling into the river during a barbecue but was transported in critical condition; police are investigating the circumstances.

title: Summer Koshien quarterfinalists set: debutant Ariake faces Kenkoh Takasaki
summary: Eight teams reach the final eight; newcomer Ariake, which staged three comebacks, will play Kenkoh Takasaki, while Yokohama and Kasumigaura also advance.
